title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
Review fixes are in.

1. A node added inside an existing blocked element is no longer recorded. The check starts at the parent, so a newly blocked element is still a placeholder. Moving an existing node into a blocked element records only the remove. The secret text is not in the event. ADR 0025.
2. `nextId` no longer mints an id. It is the first following sibling the mirror already knows, or `null`. ADR 0026.

No older test expectation changed. Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. All five fuzz seeds still pass, and the suite finishes in about two seconds.
